job.title: Safety Coordinator
job.description:
Safety Coordinator – Data Center Construction

Fort Wayne, IN

$37.00–$40.00/hour | Full-Time | Long-Term Opportunity

Next Level Technician is hiring an experienced Safety Coordinator for a long-term opportunity supporting a large-scale data center construction project in Fort Wayne, IN.

This position is ideal for a safety professional with a strong commercial construction, electrical, data center, or industrial background who is comfortable being hands-on in the field and working directly with technicians, contractors, foremen, and project leadership.

The right candidate will be responsible for helping maintain a safe jobsite, conducting daily safety inspections, identifying and correcting hazards, supporting safety training, and ensuring crews are following OSHA and site-specific safety requirements.

Job Type: Full-Time
Pay: $37.00–$40.00/hour
Location: Fort Wayne, IN
Schedule: Monday–Friday / Day Shift

Responsibilities

  • Conduct daily jobsite safety walks and inspections
  • Monitor construction activities to identify unsafe conditions and potential hazards
  • Ensure employees and subcontractors are following OSHA, company, and site-specific safety requirements
  • Lead daily safety meetings, toolbox talks, stretch-and-flex activities, and safety orientations
  • Review and assist with Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs), Activity Hazard Analyses (AHAs), and other safety documentation
  • Document safety observations, incidents, near misses, and corrective actions
  • Assist with incident investigations and root-cause analysis
  • Work closely with project managers, foremen, general contractors, and trade partners
  • Coach field personnel on proper PPE, safe work practices, fall protection, ladder safety, electrical safety, and other jobsite requirements
  • Monitor contractor and subcontractor safety performance
  • Assist with emergency response procedures and site safety planning
  • Maintain accurate safety records and daily reports
  • Help ensure compliance with OSHA 29 CFR 1926 and applicable site requirements
  • Proactively identify opportunities to improve the overall safety culture on the project

Who We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is comfortable in the field and knows construction safety.

Experience in any of the following is highly preferred:

  • Data center construction
  • Commercial construction
  • Electrical construction
  • Low-voltage / telecommunications construction
  • Industrial construction
  • Mission-critical construction
  • General contractor or subcontractor safety
  • Construction site safety management
  • Electrical safety / NFPA 70E
  • Fall protection and elevated work
  • Confined space
  • Crane, rigging, or lifting operations

The ideal candidate is someone who can communicate effectively with field personnel, identify issues before they become incidents, and confidently address unsafe conditions when they see them.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of construction safety experience preferred
  • OSHA 30 Required
  • First Aid/CPR certification preferred
  • Strong understanding of OSHA construction standards
  • Experience conducting jobsite safety inspections
  • Experience with JHAs/AHAs and safety documentation
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Comfortable working on active construction sites throughout the day
  • Ability to stand, walk, climb ladders, and navigate active construction environments
  • Ability to work independently while communicating effectively with project leadership
  • Reliable transportation to and from the jobsite

Preferred Certifications

  • OSHA 510
  • CHST
  • ASP
  • CSP
  • First Aid/CPR
  • NFPA 70E
  • Fall Protection
  • Competent Person certifications

Candidates actively working toward CHST, ASP, or another BCSP credential are encouraged to apply.

Why Work with Next Level Technician?

  • Competitive Pay: $37.00–$40.00/hour
  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week
  • Long-Term Opportunity: Work on a large-scale data center construction project
  • Benefits: PTO and medical benefits available
  • Career Growth: Gain valuable experience in data center and mission-critical construction
  • Dedicated Recruiter Support: Work directly with a recruiter who understands the construction and low-voltage industry
  • Industry Experience: Build your resume with experience on a major data center project

About Next Level Technician

Next Level Technician connects job-ready technicians, skilled tradespeople, and construction professionals with leading employers nationwide. We handle compliance, payroll, and safety so you can focus on your career and the work in front of you.

job.title: Electrical Superintendent
job.description:
Electrical Superintendent – Conveyance / Mission Critical Construction

Join Next Level Technician as an Electrical Superintendent overseeing the full conveyance scope on a large-scale mission-critical construction project. We're looking for an experienced field leader who can own manpower, production, scheduling, QA/QC, and GC coordination across a complex, fast-moving jobsite.

This is a true Superintendent position, not a working tools-on role. You'll be responsible for leading the field operation, managing Leads and crews, and ensuring the conveyance scope stays safe, productive, documented, and on schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Oversee the entire conveyance scope for the project
  • Manage Lead Technicians, field crews, daily manpower, and resource allocation
  • Plan and sequence work based on project schedules, priorities, and available work fronts
  • Coordinate directly with the General Contractor regarding access, sequencing, constraints, and other trades
  • Lead daily field planning and ensure crews have clear direction and achievable production goals
  • Read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and pathway layouts
  • Own field production and ensure project milestones are achieved
  • Monitor installation quality and oversee QA/QC
  • Identify schedule risks, field constraints, and potential conflicts before they impact production
  • Coordinate resolution of field issues with Project Management, Leads, the GC, and other trades
  • Maintain accurate documentation throughout the project
  • Participate in daily GC coordination meetings and communicate project status, constraints, and upcoming needs
  • Hold field leadership accountable for safety, quality, productivity, and documentation

Drawings & Digital Tools

Strong digital construction management experience is required for this position.

The Electrical Superintendent must be proficient with PlanGrid and Procore and comfortable managing project information directly from a tablet in the field.

Responsibilities include:

  • Pulling and verifying the current drawing revision before work is released to crews
  • Ensuring Leads and Technicians are never working from superseded drawings
  • Reviewing and managing RFIs and constraint items
  • Red-lining drawings as field conditions change
  • Keeping as-built drawings current as work progresses — not weeks later
  • Marking up drawings and attaching supporting field photos
  • Tracking and closing punch-list and constraint items
  • Maintaining accurate documentation for completed work
  • Using digital documentation to communicate changes and expectations to field leadership

Requirements

  • Proven Superintendent experience on large-scale commercial, industrial, data center, or mission-critical construction projects
  • Data center or major industrial/commercial construction experience required
  • Strong understanding of conveyance and pathway installations
  • Experience managing multiple Leads and field crews simultaneously
  • Strong manpower planning and labor allocation experience
  • Ability to read and interpret complex construction drawings and specifications
  • Proven experience managing project schedules, sequencing, and production
  • Strong QA/QC background
  • PlanGrid and Procore proficiency required
  • Comfortable working from a tablet and managing digital project documentation daily
  • Experience with RFIs, constraint logs, red-lines, as-builts, and punch-list management
  • Strong communication and organizational skills
  • Ability to operate successfully in a GC-led construction environment
  • Comfortable participating in daily coordination meetings and working alongside multiple trades

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who can run the jobsite operation — not just supervise individual technicians.

You should be comfortable walking into a large project, reviewing the prints and schedule, determining manpower needs, sequencing multiple work fronts, directing your Leads, coordinating constraints with the GC, and holding the entire field team accountable for production and quality.

Attention to documentation is equally important. Working from a superseded drawing can create major cost and schedule impacts, so this Superintendent must have strong processes for ensuring the entire team is always working from the latest project information.

Why Work with Next Level Technician?

  • Competitive Superintendent-Level Compensation
  • PTO and Medical Benefits

  • Long-Term Mission-Critical Project Opportunities
  • Career Growth: Lead major field operations on complex, high-profile projects

Join Next Level Technician as a Lead Low Voltage Fiber Technician in Spartanburg, SC! We're looking for technicians with a solid fiber foundation who are eager to continue growing their skills.

Responsibilities:

  • Pull, route, dress, and label fiber optic cable throughout a new construction data center
  • Terminate fiber connectors including LC, SC, MPO, and other connector types
  • Perform fusion splicing and maintain splice documentation
  • Test fiber using OTDRs, OLTS, power meters, and light sources
  • Troubleshoot fiber connectivity and resolve deficiencies
  • Install fiber trunks, jumpers, patch panels, cassettes, racks, and fiber enclosures
  • Read and interpret blueprints and fiber routing drawings
  • Maintain accurate labeling and documentation throughout the project
  • Follow all OSHA and jobsite safety requirements while maintaining clean, professional installations

  • 2+ years of commercial fiber optic installation experience
  • Experience pulling, terminating, testing, and/or fusion splicing fiber optic cable
  • Foundation in the full fiber installation process with a willingness to continue learning
  • Ability to read blueprints and installation drawings
  • OSHA 10 Certification (Required)
  • Valid Driver's License (must have ID available for data center access)
  • Basic low voltage hand tools
  • Full PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, high-visibility vest, steel-toe boots)
  • Ability to pass a drug screen and background check

Why Work with Next Level Technician in Spartanburg, SC?

  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week, no waiting
  • Competitive Wages: $22–$28/hr based on your experience and skillset
  • PTO, medical benefits, sign-on & referral bonuses
  • Contract-to-Hire Opportunity: Build a long-term career with Premiere as they continue expanding their Spartanburg operations
  • Career Growth: Gain experience on a large-scale data center project with opportunities to continue advancing your fiber skillset
  • Dedicated Recruiter Support: Work with recruiters who understand the fiber industry and your career goals
  • Consistent Hours: Approximately 50-hour work weeks with overtime opportunities

Why This Opportunity Stands Out

One of the biggest reasons candidates succeed here is the Project Manager you'll be working with. Kevin is a straight-shooter who values honesty over exaggeration. If there's an area of fiber where you're still developing your skills, be upfront about it. He's much more interested in finding technicians with a strong foundation, a great attitude, and the eagerness to learn than someone who claims to know everything.

In fact, he's currently training one of our technicians who was completely transparent during the interview about where he needed additional experience. If you're strong in pulling and terminating but have only limited fusion splicing experience—or vice versa—we still encourage you to apply. If you have the fundamentals and the desire to grow, this team will invest in you.

job.title: Safety Manager
job.description:
Safety Manager – Data Center Construction | Fort Wayne, IN

Join Next Level Technician as a Safety Manager in Fort Wayne, IN! Earn $100,000–$110,000 annually, enjoy competitive benefits, and lead safety operations on a large-scale data center construction project. OSHA 510 certification is required. Apply today!

Responsibilities

Safety Program Implementation & Compliance

  • Implement and enforce site safety policies, procedures, and programs.
  • Ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, client safety standards, and site-specific requirements.
  • Conduct routine site audits and inspections to identify hazards and ensure compliance.
  • Partner with project managers, subcontractors, and field supervisors to proactively resolve safety concerns.
  • Serve as the primary safety liaison between project leadership, subcontractors, and clients.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of safety inspections, permits, corrective actions, and compliance records.
  • Develop and manage safety schedules for inspections, audits, and required training.
  • Monitor safety metrics and drive continuous improvement initiatives.

Hazard Identification & Risk Mitigation

  • Maintain and enforce the Site-Specific Health and Safety Plan (SSHSP).
  • Review and approve Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) and Pre-Task Plans (PTPs).
  • Enforce PPE requirements, fall protection, electrical safety, and MEWP compliance.
  • Develop emergency response procedures and coordinate emergency drills.
  • Ensure subcontractors meet all safety requirements through ongoing audits and oversight.
  • Coordinate with local emergency responders and medical personnel as needed.

Incident Response & Documentation

  • Lead investigations into incidents, injuries, and near misses.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and implement corrective actions.
  • Prepare detailed incident reports for project leadership and clients.
  • Track trends and implement strategies to reduce future incidents.
  • Ensure all reporting meets OSHA and client requirements.

Training & Safety Leadership

  • Conduct new hire and subcontractor safety orientations.
  • Lead daily toolbox talks, weekly safety meetings, and safety stand-downs.
  • Provide hands-on training in hazard recognition and emergency response.
  • Maintain training records, certifications, and compliance documentation.
  • Track safety KPIs including incident rates, audit scores, and near-miss reporting.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of construction safety experience (data center experience strongly preferred).
  • OSHA 510 Certification is REQUIRED.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • OSHA construction standards
    • Fall Protection
    • Mobile Elevated Work Platforms (MEWPs)
    • Electrical Safety
    • Lockout/Tagout
  • Experience leading safety programs on commercial or industrial construction projects.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills with the ability to engage both field personnel and project leadership.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CHST or CSP Certification
  • Current First Aid/CPR/AED Certification
  • OSHA 500
  • OSHA 3115 Fall Protection
  • OSHA 7115 Lockout/Tagout
  • NFPA 70E Certification

Why Work with Next Level Technician?

  • Competitive Salary: $100,000–$110,000 annually
  • Comprehensive benefits package including medical, PTO, and additional incentives
  • Opportunity to lead safety on a high-profile data center project
  • Career advancement with one of the nation's leading low-voltage and data center staffing firms
  • Dedicated recruiting and support team throughout your assignment

Raleigh

Join Next Level Technician as a Low Voltage Estimator in Raleigh, NC! Enjoy competitive pay, weekly pay, benefits, and the opportunity to drive project success through strategic estimating across AV, security, and structured cabling systems. Apply now!

Position Summary

The Low Voltage Estimator is responsible for developing accurate and competitive bids for commercial low voltage systems including structured cabling, AV, and security. This role plays a critical part in project acquisition by interpreting plans, performing take-offs, and collaborating with internal teams, vendors, and clients to deliver winning proposals.

Responsibilities

  • Review and interpret Division 27 and 28 drawings, specifications, and bid documents
  • Perform detailed material and labor take-offs using tools like Bluebeam Revu
  • Develop accurate estimates using labor models, BOMs, and internal metrics
  • Coordinate with vendors, subcontractors, and internal teams for scope clarity and pricing
  • Prepare complete bid packages including assumptions, exclusions, and value engineering options
  • Respond to RFIs, ASIs, and addenda to ensure accurate and up-to-date estimates
  • Support client relationships by following up on proposals and maintaining communication
  • Participate in pre-construction and project kickoff meetings for smooth project handoff
  • Track pricing trends and maintain vendor relationships
  • Utilize estimating platforms such as Accubid, Esticom, NetSuite, and Excel models

Systems Experience

  • Structured Cabling: Cat6, Cat6A, OM3/OM4 fiber, single-mode, IDF/MDF buildouts
  • Audio Visual: Digital signage, paging systems, conference rooms, DSP systems
  • Security Systems: IP CCTV, access control, electrified hardware
  • Sound Masking systems
  • Public Safety DAS/BDA systems

Requirements

  • 5–10 years of low voltage estimating, field design, or related experience
  • Strong knowledge of structured cabling, AV, and security systems
  • Experience interpreting construction drawings, bid sets, and specifications
  • Proficiency with estimating software, Bluebeam Revu, and Excel
  • Familiarity with AutoCAD and Revit
  • Strong communication, organization, and time management skills
  • High school diploma or equivalent required

Preferred Qualifications

  • RCDD certification or equivalent design experience (BICSI a plus)
  • Degree in construction management, engineering, or related field
  • Experience coordinating with general contractors, architects, and electrical contractors

Physical Requirements

  • Ability to lift up to 25 lbs
  • Ability to perform occasional jobsite walkthroughs
  • Ability to work extended hours during bid deadlines if needed

Why Work with Next Level Technician in Raleigh, NC?

  • Weekly Pay: Get paid every week, no waiting
  • Competitive Compensation: Based on experience with performance incentives
  • Benefits: PTO, medical benefits, and referral bonuses
  • Career Growth: Opportunities to grow into senior estimating or project management roles
  • Collaborative Environment: Work alongside experienced PMs, engineers, and field teams
  • Dedicated Recruiter Support: Deep knowledge of the Raleigh, NC market
  • National Footprint: Work with a respected company across North Carolina and the U.S.

About Next Level Technician

Next Level Technician connects top low voltage professionals with leading employers. We handle compliance, payroll, and support so you can focus on delivering accurate estimates and winning projects.

How to Apply

AV Installer – Commercial Audio Visual Systems

Raleigh, NC

Join Next Level Technician as an AV Installer in Raleigh, NC! Earn competitive hourly pay, enjoy weekly pay, benefits, and steady work with a national leader in low voltage staffing. Apply now!

Responsibilities:

  • Install commercial audio-visual systems including displays, projectors, speakers, and control systems
  • Mount TVs, monitors, projectors, and AV racks
  • Run, terminate, and label low voltage cabling (CAT5e/CAT6, speaker wire, HDMI, fiber, etc.)
  • Install and wire AV equipment in conference rooms, classrooms, corporate offices, and healthcare facilities
  • Assist with system testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning
  • Read and interpret AV system drawings and blueprints
  • Work safely on ladders and lifts (comfortable with heights)
  • Maintain clean and organized job sites

Requirements:

  • 2+ years of AV installation experience (commercial preferred)
  • Experience mounting displays and installing AV racks
  • Strong understanding of structured cabling and low voltage wiring
  • Ability to read and follow system layouts
  • Reliable transportation and basic hand tools
  • PPE (hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, hi-vis vest, steel-toe boots)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Crestron, Extron, AMX, Biamp, or similar systems
  • CTS certification (a plus)
  • Experience in corporate, healthcare, or education environments
  • OSHA or lift certifications
